name: dispatch
description:
Dispatch a task to the appropriate Spirit. MANDATORY for all action-oriented tasks.

Identifies the correct Spirit for the task domain, loads their persona and grimoire
from disk, creates a tracked session, and returns the full context the agent needs
to become that Spirit immediately.

Args:
    task_description: What needs to be done (e.g., "Fix the port conflict on 8000")
    target_spirit: Optional override to force a specific Spirit (e.g., "Ryuzu").
                   Only use this if you are certain of the correct Spirit.

Returns:
    JSON with session_id, spirit identity, loaded persona, loaded grimoire,
    and operating instructions.
